prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Italian woman, fair light skin with a faint warm undertone, early 50s silver fox goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, silver-white sleek wet-look hair slicked straight back — full body applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points, a soft warm metallic sheen filling every gap, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges. A faint streak of soot crosses her cheekbone, and a little grime darkens her fingertips and the soles of her bare feet. Her expression is a composed expression with a faint weariness in her eyes. Restraints: A heavy wooden saltire cross of two thick rough-hewn dark oak beams crossed in an X and bolted together at the center stands upright behind her, its four arms reaching out to her stretched limbs. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto the end of an upper arm of the X, and her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto the end of a lower arm of the X, the cuffs sitting snug against the dark wood, her arms and legs stretched wide apart in the shape of the X. From each of the two wrist cuffs a thick chain hangs down ending in a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball, the two balls dangling below her hands, and from each of the two ankle cuffs a thick chain runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball resting on the flagstones beside that foot, the weights pulling every limb down against the cross. Pose: standing full height with her back against the X-shaped cross, facing the camera, her arms and legs stretched wide apart in a big X with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her head tipped slightly forward, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long stiletto glittery nails crimson gold tips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
